q.line: Well, Frankie went in the army
stanza: Well, Frankie went in the army
Settled down, took Maria for my wife
But them wheat prices kept on dropping
'Til it was like we were getting robbed
And me, I took this job

partner.line: But them wheat prices kept on dropping

q.line: Dad was a captain in the army
stanza: Dad was a captain in the army
Didn't know a soul in L.A.
So we went down to the Union Station
